premises.text: Many Americans are denied the opportunity to build credit because they need credit to establish credit.
premises.evidence_span: for many, building payment history is as easy as using your credit card to buy stuff, paying it off, and then repeating. Yet, for millions of Americans, are denied this basic opportunity, because in order to build or establish credit, first, you need credit.

premises.text: One in four Americans do not have a credit score, and 100 million Americans have subprime credit.
premises.evidence_span: as a result, one in four Americans do not have a credit score, and 100 million Americans have subprime credit, with scores below 650.

premises.text: Building credit is hard and not having credit is expensive and limiting.
premises.evidence_span: the problem is, building credit is hard. Not having credit is expensive and very limiting.

premises.text: SelfLender enables users to build positive payment history, which is crucial for determining credit scores.
premises.evidence_span: SelfLender enables our users to build positive payment history, the most important factor in determining your credit score.

premises.text: SelfLender's model is based on a low-cost subscription that allows users to choose their payment history amount and term.
premises.evidence_span: Signing up with SelfLender is easy, takes less than three minutes, and only costs $3 per month.

premises.text: SelfLender reports users' payment performance to credit bureaus.
premises.evidence_span: SelfLender reports her monthly payment performance to the credit bureaus.

premises.text: Transitioning from no credit score to a prime credit score significantly impacts financial life.
premises.evidence_span: moving from no credit score to having a prime credit score has a significant impact on a person's financial life.

premises.text: SelfLender can save users significant amounts of money over their lifetime.
premises.evidence_span: studies show that a person who transitions in a prime credit has an average lifetime savings of $250,000 in fees and interest.

premises.text: SelfLender has the potential to help millions of Americans in the subprime market.
premises.evidence_span: imagine if SelfLender could help just 1% of the 100 million Americans in the subprime market.

value.text: SelfLender empowers users with tools for financial improvement and access to affordable financial products.
value.evidence_span: SelfLender empowers our users with the tools for active, do-it-yourself financial improvement.
